test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
A cube is made by folding the given sheet. In the cube so formed, which number will be on the face opposite to the face showing '8'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e289273bf8d6a77e8b8a0ff8eae05992e97eb9ecbd4ec39244150c8e515980cc.png]
solution:
Faces opposite to each other is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c3ac629963a18c3491abede2b2e156fcda6d2a80282b4d4e736019ed5f47053.png] 

6 → 2

3 → 1

4 → 8

Clearly, '4' will be on the face opposite to the face showing '8'.

Hence, '**4**' is the correct answer.
